g.text: CloudSec: system architecture -- agentic gate (Stages 1-3) + real-time detector (Stage 4)
Pre-execution agentic gate: (1) screen -> (2) harden -> (3) predict events -> Stage 4 scores risk
(below threshold: allow & execute; above: revise template and rescore).
Runtime: real CloudTrail -> ingestion_gate -> benign to Neo4j + LSTM history; malicious to a revised template.
